title: Photo 240 · 텐트폴 USSBBW · 말라카이트 · 무릎 꿇기 옆 (양 무릎) · 동아프리카 50대 후반
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph on a plain seamless mid-grey backdrop, nothing in the frame but a low flat platform, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking in from one side so the texture of the skin stands out, sharp focus from head to toe, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Subject: ONE real adult East African woman in her late 50s, lines at the eyes, mouth and neck, deep umber skin tone with a warm sheen, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, long box braids gathered high on her head, a calm confident expression, real living eyes. She wears wide disc earrings and has short rounded nails with a high gloss.

Physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, her body so deep from front to back that her belly reaches beyond one edge of the frame and her rear beyond the other. A giant hourglass frame that flares out at both ends: enormous flaring lats spreading to shoulders twice the width of a normal woman's, massive rounded deltoids stacked on top of them, huge thick arms pushed far out from her sides by the width of her back, a smooth rounded neck, a colossal bust projecting forward past the line of her shoulders, no waist at all. A great mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle and drops straight down from it under its own weight, projecting far forward past the line of her own knees before it falls, settling onto the tops of her thighs and piling over them, gathering into two or three heavy rounded folds as it falls, deep shadowed creases between them, the surface soft and uneven, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum. It merges seamlessly into her sides, her hips and her thighs with no boundary anywhere, one continuous body rather than a separate mass, not pregnant. Below it colossal wide hips just as broad as her shoulders, a huge rounded rear, colossal thighs pressing together down to the knees and thick heavy calves. Her head looks small on top of her massive frame and her shoulders span more than five head-widths. Wide above and wide below; the muscle is huge but rounded and soft-edged under a thick layer of fat, no bodybuilder look. Every fold and curve keeps its own clear rounded outline with a deep shadowed crease between them, never merging into one shapeless mass. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. The flesh is soft and loose at this age, every fold hanging low and settling deep over the one below it. The sheer weight of the flesh is visible in how it drops, settles and presses down onto the thighs beneath it.

Skin: Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, coarse surface grain and fine crepey texture across the softest areas, natural creases and shadow where the flesh folds, faint stretch marks where the great curves have expanded, the raking light picking out every ridge and hollow of the surface. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in polished malachite style — vivid emerald and deep forest green in concentric swirling bands that follow every deep crease and curve around the hips and thighs like contour lines on a map, a thin gold line between the bands. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge and cracks a little where the skin folds. The paint covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: her shoulders, her upper arms, her forearms and the backs of her hands are painted as densely as her torso, and so are the sides of her body, her back, her rear, the lower belly, the knees, the calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.

Pose: Kneeling upright on the platform seen from directly to her side, both calves folded beneath her thighs and her rear settled back onto her heels, her back straight, her near hand resting on her thigh and her far arm held back so nothing crosses in front of her torso, her head turned toward the camera, the whole depth of her body read from the side, full body head to knees filling the frame.

Footwear: Extreme emerald-green platform stiletto slingbacks, the platform soles as tall as her ankle bones, the ultra-thin stiletto heels so high her insteps stand nearly vertical.

Background & Lighting: the polished green bands gleaming, the hard raking light carving every fold and curve.

Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide.
